claim: The statute recognizes exceptionally few exceptions, applying strictly to the sale of the goodwill of a business (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code Section 16601), the dissolution of a partnership (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code Section 16602), or the dissolution of a limited liability company (Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code Section 16602.5)
evidence: Certain exceptions to Section 16600 allow such agreements including in connection with the sale of a business, the dissolution of, or disassociation from, a partnership or limited liability company, provided certain eligibility factors are met. Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code Sections 16601, 16602, 16602.5.

[2] Certain exceptions to Section 16600 allow such agreements including in connection with the sale of a business, the dissolution of, or disassociation from, a partnership or limited liability company, provided certain eligibility factors are met. Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code Sections 16601, 16602, 16602.5. Consequently, this should not affect restrictive covenants entered into validly in connection with a deal.
